source.title: Request Lifecycle
source.note: Only this file was used as test basis. References to docs/06-business-rules.md §5 and supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql were not read.

states.name: DRAFT
states.quote: | `DRAFT` | Created, never submitted. No gates have run. | no |

states.name: SUBMITTED
states.quote: | `SUBMITTED` | Transient. The submit call runs all four gates and leaves this state immediately — a request should never be observed sitting in `SUBMITTED`. | no |

states.name: UNDER_REVIEW
states.quote: | `UNDER_REVIEW` | All gates passed. Awaiting a reviewer decision. | no |

states.name: APPROVED
states.quote: | `APPROVED` | Authorised. Still cancellable until the deadline (see below). | no |

states.name: REJECTED
states.quote: | `REJECTED` | Failed a gate, or refused by a reviewer. `failing_gate` and `rejection_reason` are populated. | **yes** |

states.name: COMPLETED
states.quote: | `COMPLETED` | Flight concluded. Set **only** by the maintenance completion endpoint — never inferred from elapsed time. | **yes** |

actions.name: complete
actions.quote: Maintenance endpoint only — never inferred from elapsed time

invalid_rule.quote: **Any transition not shown below is invalid and must return `409`**

partitions.class: legal (from, action) pair (8 pairs from the table)

equivalence_partitions.quote: Every other pair — e.g. `REJECTED`→anything, `CANCELLED`→anything, `COMPLETED`→anything, or re-submitting something already `UNDER_REVIEW` — is illegal and returns `409`.
`SUBMITTED` resolves immediately into either `UNDER_REVIEW` (all gates passed) or `REJECTED` (a gate failed).

equivalence_partitions.variable: time of cancel relative to window_start for APPROVED

partitions.expected: 409 (implied by 'only up to 2 hours before'), stays APPROVED

equivalence_partitions.quote: Cancelling an `APPROVED` request is only allowed **up to 2 hours before `window_start`**. Closer than that, the cancel endpoint should reject it (`409` — this is a state-transition question, not a gate failure).

equivalence_partitions.variable: time-based cancel restriction for non-APPROVED states

partitions.class: DRAFT / UNDER_REVIEW cancel less than 2h before window_start
partitions.expected: CANCELLED (deadline is stated only for APPROVED) — confirm, see U-06

equivalence_partitions.quote: Cancelling an `APPROVED` request is only allowed **up to 2 hours before `window_start`**.

equivalence_partitions.variable: state of another request for the same aircraft (overlap check)

partitions.representative: other request APPROVED with overlapping window
other request CANCELLED with overlapping window

equivalence_partitions.quote: Only `APPROVED` and `UNDER_REVIEW` requests are counted by the overlap check inside the `AIRCRAFT` / `TIME_WINDOW` gates. `DRAFT`, `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED` and `COMPLETED` are invisible to it

partitions.representative: APPROVED with window in the past

equivalence_partitions.quote: Set **only** by the maintenance completion endpoint — never inferred from elapsed time.

values.expected: CANCELLED if 'up to' is inclusive (assumed, see U-05)

boundary_values.quote: Cancelling an `APPROVED` request is only allowed **up to 2 hours before `window_start`**.
boundary_values.notes: Time granularity (seconds/minutes) and clock source not specified (U-05).

boundary_values.quote: Closer than that, the cancel endpoint should reject it (`409` — this is a state-transition question, not a gate failure).
boundary_values.notes: All three are on the invalid side; confirms no other rule applies after start.

boundary_values.boundary: overlap between this request and an APPROVED/UNDER_REVIEW request for the same aircraft
boundary_values.quote: which is why a request that passed `validate` can still fail at `submit`, if another request for the same aircraft was approved in the interim.
boundary_values.notes: Overlap rule definition is not in this file.

state_transition_table.quote: | `DRAFT` | submit | `SUBMITTED` → immediately `UNDER_REVIEW` or `REJECTED` | Gates run synchronously; caller never observes `SUBMITTED` at rest |
state_transition_table.notes: Two sub-cases: all gates pass -> UNDER_REVIEW; any gate fails -> REJECTED with failing_gate/rejection_reason populated. Caller must never see SUBMITTED in the response or on re-read.

Error code not specified (409? 422?); whether empty/whitespace note counts as missing; max length.
'up to 2 hours before' — is exactly 2h allowed? Time unit precision and time zone/clock source not specified.
